{"consolidated_memory":"NaN FEATURE ENCODER ISSUES IN ml/features/encoder.py (Two separate incidents)

INCIDENT 1: [2026-04-05]
- Component: ml/features/encoder.py (same corner as earlier NaN feature work)
- Problem: NaN feature in the feature encoder
- Trigger: Traffic arriving through the corporate proxy only
- Signal: Not-a-number value in one output column
- Root cause: Off-by-one in the slice bound
- Fix: Corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- PR: #2515 on branch fix/nan-feature-3
- Repro: Encode the batch holding the sparse column
- Performance outcome: Cold start dropped 56 percent, to 980 ms

INCIDENT 2: [2026-08-01]
- Component: ml/features/encoder.py (same corner as earlier NaN feature work)
- Problem: NaN feature in the feature encoder
- Trigger: Input list came in empty only
- Signal: Not-a-number value in one output column
- Root cause: Unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: Capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR: #5195 on branch fix/nan-feature-4
- Repro: Encode the batch holding the sparse column
- Performance outcome: P99 latency fell from 3.8 s to 90 ms

Both issues appeared in the same localized area of the encoder but had distinct underlying causes and required separate fixes."}
